The design is fixed and all tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).

Two bugs were corrected in `rtl/traffic_light.v`:
1. SY phase was using `MAIN_YELLOW_T` instead of `SIDE_YELLOW_T` for its duration.
2. The pedestrian-shortening check used `timer == MAIN_GREEN_MIN - 1` instead of `timer >= MAIN_GREEN_MIN - 1`, which failed to shorten MG when a request arrived after the timer had already passed that point.
